_comment: Hinae Shirasuzu, the white bell shrine maiden (SLICE_PLAN 3.4, kit sheet docs/heroes-v2/kits/hinae_shirasuzu.txt). The kit fields are the slice fixture's (src/test/resources/heroes/slice/hinae_shirasuzu.json); art and animations are source only (HEROES_V2 12.5, 12.6). One body for good (the owner's rule of 2026-11-13, HEROES_V2 3.6): an adult of ordinary size, standard build, drawn at 96%.
name: Hinae Shirasuzu
title: the White Bell
description: A gentle shrine keeper whose talismans never miss when she finally throws them.

transition.line: Please... stop. I don't want to hurt you.
Then I'll purify this fight myself!

intro.line: Welcome, traveller. Will you put your weapon down? ...No? I'm sorry, then.

quirks: apologises to the monsters she defeats

leader.title: Keeper of the White Bell
leader.motto: Every lantern lit, every door open.

founding: Everyone, welcome home. From today we are the Hearth of the White Bell.
greeting: {player}! Have you eaten? There's rice by the station.
escape: I'm sorry... I can't stay. Please, let that be enough.
last_stand: I won't leave them. Not while one lantern is still lit.
fallen: The bell... someone, please, keep it ringing...

hinae.tf_wind._comment: Talisman Fan wind-up: the hips and chest turned to her right, the left hand cocked across in front of the right shoulder with the fan of talismans pointing up and out to the right, the wand hand drawn back to the right hip.

hinae.tf_throw._comment: Talisman Fan release: the left arm swept forward at chest height with the fan flat and pointing at the target, the chest turning back square, the wand hand low by the right hip.

hinae.tf_follow._comment: Talisman Fan follow-through: the sweep carried on out to her left, the arm long and the fan pointing out to the left-front as the five talismans fan away, the chest turned after it.

hinae.pu_raise._comment: Purify wind-up: the wand raised upright before her face with the left hand under it at the chest, the head bowed a little over it (a short prayer).

hinae.pu_sweep._comment: Purify release: the wand swept out and up to her right in one wide stroke (the cleansing wave), the bells and streamers flying, the chest turned after it, the left hand still at the chest.

hinae.pu_back._comment: Purify recovery: the wand swept back across to her left in a smaller second wave, the chest turned left.

hinae.sc_raise._comment: Sealing Circle wind-up: the wand raised high and upright at her right side, ringing its bells, the fan of talismans held up before the chest, the chest leaning back a little.

hinae.sc_load._comment: Sealing Circle, the last beat of the wind-up: the wand a little higher and further back, the chest arched.

hinae.sc_strike._comment: Sealing Circle release: the wand brought down sharply to point forward and down at the ground under the target, the body leaning in behind it, the fan of talismans drawn back to the left hip.

hinae.ex_gather._comment: Exorcise wind-up: knees bent, both hands drawn together before the chest, the wand upright with the fan of talismans pressed behind it, the head bowed: gathering light.

hinae.ex_load._comment: Exorcise, the end of the wind-up: a little deeper, the hands pressed lower, the head down.

hinae.ex_burst._comment: Exorcise release: up out of the crouch, both arms flung out wide to the sides with the props pointing out, the chest open and the head up: the burst of light all around her.

hinae.st_pray._comment: Seven Talismans wind-up: the wand upright before her face, the fan of talismans held high in the left hand, the head bowed, eyes closed; the ring of talismans draws in tight and rises.

hinae.st_pray2._comment: Seven Talismans, the end of the wind-up: the ring drawn in tighter, the head bowed lower.

hinae.st_spread._comment: Seven Talismans release: both arms swept out wide and up, the chest open, the eyes open: the ring flies out into the barrier.

hinae.ul_hold._comment: Thousand Bell Rite, the opening: the wand held upright before the chest in both hands, the head bowed over it, eyes closed.

hinae.ul_raise._comment: Thousand Bell Rite wind-up: the wand raised high overhead at her right, ringing, the left arm opened out to the side palm up, the chest leaning back and the face lifted to the bells; the ring of talismans widens and rises.

hinae.ul_load._comment: Thousand Bell Rite, the last beat: the wand drawn a little further up and back.

hinae.ul_release._comment: Thousand Bell Rite release: the wand swept down in a wide arc to point out at the front-right, the body leaning in, the left arm flung out the other way: the rite blooms; the ring of talismans flares out.

hinae.ul_bow._comment: Thousand Bell Rite recovery: the wand lowered to the chest, upright, both hands on it, a small bow.

hinae.p2_plead._comment: Phase 2: pleading, the fan of talismans held up before her chest, the wand lowered at her side, the head tilted and the shoulders up; the ring of talismans begins to unfold.

hinae.p2_open._comment: Phase 2: the left hand sweeps out to open the ring, the fan pointing out to the left, the wand raised to guard before her; the seven talismans spread round her.

hinae.p3_bow._comment: Phase 3: the head bowed over the wand held upright at the chest in both hands, eyes closed.

hinae.p3_rise._comment: Phase 3: the head up with the eyes open and glowing, the wand swept up and out to her right on a diagonal, the fan of talismans thrust forward at the enemy.

hinae.in_bow._comment: Intro: a polite bow, the wand held upright before the chest with the left hand under it, eyes closed.

hinae.in_raise._comment: Intro: upright again, the wand raised before her and offered toward the stranger, the left hand open at her side with the fan of talismans down.

hinae.vi_sigh._comment: Victory: relief, the shoulders dropping, the wand and the fan lowered, the head bowed.

hinae.vi_bow._comment: Victory: the hands together before the chest round the upright wand, a small bow toward the one she defeated (she apologises to them).

hinae.vi_smile._comment: Victory: upright with the head tilted and a soft smile, the wand held to the chest.

hinae.ta_shoo._comment: Taunt: the wand lowered, the left hand raised at chest height with the fan of talismans upright, about to wave the enemy gently away; the head tilted.

hinae.ls_bar._comment: Last stand: the wand swept across in front of her to the left, barring the way, the chest turned after it.

hinae.ls_plant._comment: Last stand: the wand held upright before her in both hands, the chin up, set where she stands.

hinae.dn_open._comment: Purifying Dance wind-up: the kagura's opening, turned to her right, the wand raised high out to the right and ringing, the left arm long and low to the left, the head turned to the front.

hinae.dn_a._comment: Purifying Dance, the sweep's start (the hit): the wand pointing out to her right, the beam's first edge, the left arm out the other way and a little up; turned to her right.

hinae.dn_b._comment: Purifying Dance, the sweep's middle: square to the front with the knees dipped, the wand pointing straight ahead, the left arm swept up in an arc over her left shoulder.

hinae.dn_c._comment: Purifying Dance, the sweep's end (the cast): turned to her left, the wand carried across to point out to her left, the left arm trailing down and back.

hinae.dn_step_l._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: turning back to the front, the hands coming together, the left foot lifted for the step that sets her feet for the kneel (the right foot stays on its stance spot).

hinae.dn_lift._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: the left foot down beside the right's old spot, the right foot lifted to step back into the kneel; the hands together before the chest.

hinae.dn_mid._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: half way down to the knee (or up from it), the hands together.

hinae.dn_kneel._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: down on the right knee to pray, the palms together round the upright wand, the head bowed (her kneeling prayer: the channel weak point).

hinae.dn_clap._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: kneeling, the hands apart for a clap.

hinae.dn_bow._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: the kneeling bow over the joined hands, the eyes closed.

hinae.dn_rise_step._comment: Purifying Dance recovery: up again, the right foot back on its stance spot and the left lifted to step into the ready stance; the arms already in it.

hinae.pb_reach._comment: Bell shake: the left hand at the bells of the wand thrust through her sash (they hang at the left of her hips), jingling them, the head bent to the left to listen, the right hand resting at her side.

hinae.pb_listen._comment: Bell shake: the palms together before the chest, the head tilted, listening to the bells' last ring.

hinae.pt_brush_l._comment: Tidying up: the left arm lifted a little forward, the right hand brushing down the outside of its sleeve.

hinae.pt_brush_l2._comment: Tidying up: the brushing hand at the end of the stroke, down at the left sleeve's hem.

hinae.pt_brush_r._comment: Tidying up: the right arm lifted a little forward, the left hand brushing down its sleeve.

hinae.pt_brush_r2._comment: Tidying up: the left hand at the end of its stroke, down at the right sleeve's hem.

hinae.pt_smooth._comment: Tidying up: bending a little to smooth the front of the hakama with both hands.

hinae.pt_smooth2._comment: Tidying up: the hands slid down the hakama to the end of the stroke.

hinae.ring_tiny._comment: Offsets over the stance (a key with `over`): only the ring of talismans, folded up small at her chest (phase 2's first frame: the ring shows from the transition's start and unfolds from here).

hinae.st_open._comment: Seven Talismans after the release: the arms still wide, the ring back to its size.

hinae.ul_after._comment: Thousand Bell Rite after the release: held, the ring back to its size.

hinae.p2_hold._comment: Phase 2: the open pose held while the ring settles to its size.

hinae.esc_bow._comment: Escape: a quick apologetic bow over the run, the hands brought together before the chest.

move.talisman_fan.description: Talisman Fan (move slot 0, volley of 5, light: 0.5 / 0.3 / 0.4 s): the hips and chest wind round to her right while the left hand cocks the fan of talismans across in front of the right shoulder (0.25 s), a held beat, then the left arm sweeps out flat at chest height and the five talismans fly at 0.40 s (hit, tick 10), the sweep carrying on out to her left until 0.65 s (cast: the end of the active part, tick 15), the sleeve trailing, and back to her ready stance by 1.1 s. Upper body and hips.

move.sealing_circle.description: Sealing Circle (move slot 1, a zone at the target, area: 1.0 / 0.1 / 0.8 s): the wand swung up high at her right and its bells rung with the eyes closed while the fan of talismans is held before the chest (the tell: the bell ring, 0.25-0.8 s), a last lift (0.82 s), then the wand brought down sharply to point at the ground under the target at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20), 0.95 s (cast, tick 21), held, and back on guard by 1.8 s. Upper body and hips.

move.purify.description: Purify (move slot 2, allies within 8, light: 0.6 / 0.1 / 0.4 s): the wand raised upright before her face with the left hand under it, the head bowed in a short prayer with the eyes closed (0.28-0.42 s), then one wide cleansing sweep of the wand out and up to her right at 0.50 s (hit, tick 12), 0.55 s (cast, tick 13), a smaller sweep back across to the left (0.75 s) and the ready stance by 1.0 s. Upper body and hips.

move.exorcise.description: Exorcise (move slot 3, a nova of radius 4, area: 1.0 / 0.1 / 0.8 s): she sinks on bent knees and draws both hands together before her chest, the wand upright with the talismans pressed behind it, the head bowed and trembling with the light she gathers (0.35-0.85 s, the tell), then rises and flings both arms out wide at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20: the burst all round her), 0.95 s (cast, tick 21), and settles back on guard by 1.8 s. Feet planted.

move.seven_talismans.description: Seven Talismans (move slot 4, a barrier on herself, heavy: 0.8 / 0.2 / 0.8 s; phases 2-3): the wand upright before her face and the fan of talismans raised high, the head bowed with the eyes closed, while the ring of seven talismans draws in tight and rises (0.3-0.62 s, the tell), then both arms swept out wide at 0.70 s (hit, tick 16): the ring flies out into the barrier and overshoots, 0.85 s (cast, tick 19), settles to its size by 1.0 s, and the ready stance by 1.7 s. Upper body, hips and the ring's bone (its scale and height; the orbit is sec.loop's).

move.purifying_dance.description: Purifying Dance (move slot 5, a sweep of 180 degrees over 2 s, area: 1.0 / 2.0 / 1.5 s; phase 3): the kagura's opening, turned to her right with the wand raised high and ringing, eyes closed and a calm smile (0.35-0.75 s, the tell), the beam's first edge at her right at 0.90 s (hit, tick 20, the dance's release sound), then one slow sweep of the wand through the front (1.85 s, the knees dipping) to her left by 2.85 s (cast, tick 59: the end of the active part), the left arm answering it, the bells shaking; then the recovery, her weak point: a step that sets her feet, down on the right knee (3.45 s), two claps over the joined hands (3.6 and 3.75 s, the end sound) and a kneeling bow, and up again with a step back into her ready stance by 4.4 s. Feet planted through the dance; the steps lift a foot and never slide one.

ultimate.description: Thousand Bell Rite (the ultimate, channelled: 1.6 / 0.3 / 1.5 s; the channel is the wind-up and the active part, as the server breaks it): the wand held upright at the chest in both hands with the head bowed and a calm smile (0.35 s), raised slowly high overhead at her right while the left arm opens palm up and the face lifts to the bells, ringing them in a slow circle (to 1.38 s, the tell; the ring of talismans, in phase 2 and 3, widens and rises), then the wand swept down in a wide arc to the front-right at 1.50 s (hit, tick 32: the rite blooms, the ring flares out), 1.75 s (cast, tick 37: the end of the active part), held, a small bow with the wand at the chest, and her ready stance by 3.3 s. The rite's release sound is the server's; the bell loop follows the action code.

phase.2.description: Phase 2 (60%; the 1.2 s transition): 'Please... stop. I don't want to hurt you.' A sad face, the fan of talismans held up before her chest and the wand lowered at her side, the head tilted (0.3 s), while the ring of seven talismans unfolds from her chest (it shows from the transition's start, folded small); the left hand sweeps out and the ring opens to its full size with a little overshoot (0.65 s), the wand raised to guard; back on guard by 1.1 s (the clip and its blend end with the transition). Upper body and the ring.

phase.3.description: Phase 3 (25%; the 1.2 s transition): 'Then I'll purify this fight myself!' The head bowed over the wand held at the chest with the eyes closed (0.3 s), then the head comes up with the eyes open and glowing gold, the wand swept up and out on a diagonal and the fan of talismans thrust at the enemy (0.52 s), held, and back on guard by 1.1 s. Her streamers light up with the phase look. Upper body.

intro.description: Intro (code 16), 1.5 s: 'Welcome, traveller. Will you put your weapon down? ...No? I'm sorry, then.' A polite bow with the wand held upright at the chest and the eyes closed, a gentle smile (0.4-0.7 s), then upright again with the wand raised before her toward the stranger, an apologetic look (1.0 s), and her ready stance by 1.5 s. Upper body.

victory.description: Victory (code 20), 2.0 s: relief, the shoulders dropping and the eyes closing (0.35 s), the hands brought together round the wand in a small bow toward the one she defeated, an apology (0.85-1.3 s), then upright with the head tilted and a soft smile and a hum (1.6 s), and her stance by 2.0 s. Upper body.

taunt.description: Taunt (code 14), 1.4 s: a sweet-natured 'please, go home': the wand lowered, the left hand raised with the fan of talismans and waved gently side to side, the head tilted with a worried little smile, then back to her stance. Upper body.

last_stand.description: Last stand (no action code yet: for the engine side to play at the last-stand beat, HEROES_V2 6.13), 1.6 s: 'I won't leave them. Not while one lantern is still lit.' The wand swept across in front of her to bar the way, a shout (0.3 s), then held upright before her in both hands with the chin up and a determined face (0.7-1.25 s), back on guard by 1.6 s. Upper body.

escape.description: Escape (no action code yet: for the engine side to play as an escape starts, HEROES_V2 6.13), 0.6 s over the run: 'I'm sorry... I can't stay.' A quick apologetic bow with the hands together before the chest and a sad face (0.12-0.25 s), then the arms back into the run. The upper body only, over and back into move.run; the run's own follow-through keeps the hair and sleeves (no bake of its own).

personal.1.description: Bell shake (personal.1, a rare idle), 2.4 s over move.idle: the left hand drops to the bells of the wand thrust through her sash (they hang at the left of her hips) and jingles them (the wand shakes in the sash), the head bent to listen with the eyes closed and a smile, then the palms together before the chest and the head tilted while the last ring fades. Upper body and the carried wand's bone.

personal.2.description: Tidying up (personal.2, a rare idle; her sweeping quirk), 2.6 s over move.idle: a brisk sweep of the dust off the left sleeve with the right hand, then off the right sleeve with the left, then both hands smooth the front of her hakama, and a contented hum with a smile. Upper body and hips.

personal.3.description: Prayer (personal.3, a rare idle; hands together and a small bow), 2.8 s over move.idle: the palms together before the chest with the eyes closed, a nod of a bow, two claps (the sound), the palms together again and a small bow, then a smile. Upper body and hips.

sec.loop.description: The phase-2 ring's orbit on the secondary controller (HeroAnimator plays sec.loop whenever the chain has it): the seven talismans turn once round her every 6 s, wobbling a little like a floating ring (it keys only the ring's rotation, so a move may still scale or lift the ring; before phase 2 the ring's bone is hidden). A whole turn unwound at the loop's end (primitives.spin).
